judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are same-grain Indicators at the same resolved coordinate (Class IX, rank 0) sharing NCERT LO3 ('Plans and conducts investigations') as an ancestor. Neither text shows added complexity, extension, or scope that would make proficiency in one a support for success in the other, and same-rank placement offers no developmental ordering evidence, so a symmetric relatesTo rather than buildsTowards is warranted. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Indicators at the same grain, same Class IX coordinate (rank 0), same Chapter 'Gravitation' and the same Content Domain Specific Learning Outcome parent CLO71 ('Relates processes and phenomena to cause and effect, such as buoyancy, force of gravity'), so shared placement alone is not decisive. The pair-specific content is, however, substantively staged: C157 establishes the qualitative and mathematical relation between force and mass (LC tags: force, gravitation, mass, relationship), while C158 extends that reasoning to freefall by adding a second variable, distance, and applying it to a motion phenomenon (LCs: 'relates mass to freefall...' and 'relates distance to freefall...'). Proficiency in quantifying the force–mass relation supports success in analysing how mass and distance govern freefall under gravity, so a same-rank forward direction from C157 to C158 is supported by the added variable and applied complexity rather than by mere wording overlap.
